hardware.background: Chrome, Steam (steamwebhelper), Overwolf, Discord, Telegram, idle VBCSCompiler and Claude desktop app were running; total CPU load before the matrix 6%. Affinity and power settings were not changed. No Godot tests, builds or other sessions ran during the CPU matrix.

method.order: Sequential; per scenario both builds back to back, build order alternated between scenarios (base first for contact, volley, siege; current first for cavalry, approach, mixed).
method.base: origin/main d4ebc53 in a separate git worktree: the same code without the AI epic (stage K, 0-battle, 0-map, ruler_home fix).
method.dirty_note: Both builds are dirty only by files Godot writes on import: CRLF/LF of *.import, the header of project.godot and two .uid files main did not commit (ui_sounds.gd.uid, test_ui_feedback.gd.uid). No source change; source_sha256 identifies the exact tree.
method.dll_note: Native sources are identical in both trees; the DLL hashes differ (built in different folders).
